{{Top|leg}}
A '''pod''' was the term given to social grouping of various creatures.

[[Guf drolg]] traveled in pods.<ref>{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=loading|Guf Drolg|Talus}}</ref> [[Aiwha/Legends|Aiwha]] hunted in pods,<ref name="The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> leading the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] to use the term "[[Pod (cloning)|pods]]" for groups of closely-knit [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].
